main_text.p: uiuo teftatore fuus effe defineret. D. An nepos illa formula inftitutus, quã uis lex de fuccedendi tempore nihil definiat, tamen quia formula filij mor tem teftatore uiuo requirit,perperam inftitutus uideatur. Controuerfiam contrarie fcripta faciunt. Refpõdetur autem,duabus de caufis uideri recte inftitutum.Primùm, quia fecũdum le gis caput tempus non diftínxit,nec de finijt, ut tantùm poft teftatoris morte fuccedendi ius effet, non autem ante mortem. Deinde,ut maxime quis tem pus urgeat,tamen defendi etiam pof fe,filium uiuo patre fuum effe defiffe[?], quamuis poft mortem decefferit. Nā lex Cornelia fingit illum eodem decef fiffe momento, quo captus eft, quia necredijt:nec,ut euentus docuit, redi re potuit.
main_text.head: §.10. Ille casus.
main_text.p: His hunc in modū explicatis,deinceps controuersiam ad utrumq; legis caput coniunctè pertinentem Cerui dius exponit, de qua nos postremo lo co dicturos propofuimus. Quídam

page.notes: The text on this page is set in roman type with a few italic words. The main doubtful readings are "defiffe" (the last letters are blurred, so I marked it [?]) and "deinceps", which is split across a line end. The "§.10" heading is set in italic. Faint marks at the left and right edges are show-through or scan edge and are not transcribed.
